metadata.title: Convex-like Submanifolds, Caps and a Volume Comparison Theorem
metadata.abstract: Convex-like submanifolds in the Lorentz-Minkowski spaces are introduced in this paper as a natural and broad generalization of convex surfaces in the Euclidean space. Associated with such a convex-like submanifold in a Minkowski space, we define roofs (which resembles the supporting planes), caps (which are generated by the light rays in the normal bundle), and towers (which revives the notion of interior for such high codimensional objects). As a touchstone of this theory, a volume comparison theorem is proved, which is a non-trivial generalization of the obvious fact that among two nested convex surfaces, the outer one has larger volume. Finally we provide two important applications of this theorem.
metadata.comment: 31 pages, 4 figures. The authors used ChatGPT to assist in language editing and in reviewing the proofs. The authors take full responsibility for the content of this manuscript. Any comments are welcome

analysis.workSummary: 在 Lorentz–Minkowski 空间中引入 convex-like 高余维子流形，以及 roofs、caps、towers 等配套几何对象。
analysis.breakthrough: 建立推广欧氏嵌套凸曲面外层体积较大这一现象的比较定理，并给出两项应用。
analysis.limitations: 比较基于新定义的 convex-like 条件；不能对任意 Lorentz 子流形或未指定的体积概念无条件套用。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 官方 Comments 和正文均披露 ChatGPT 协助语言与证明审阅；正文具体列出 Proposition 3.1、Theorem 6.1、Proposition 7.1 和 Lemma A.2 的证明经其协助改进。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2610.31332v1 · PDF 第 4 页 Statement of AI use；官方 Comments

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。官方 Comments 和正文均披露 ChatGPT 协助语言与证明审阅；正文具体列出 Proposition 3.1、Theorem 6.1、Proposition 7.1 和 Lemma A.2 的证明经其协助改进。

analysis.priorityReason: 值得留意的高余维比较框架，具体应用范围需结合定义。
